architecture: Cloud Run control service + one Cloud Run Job per pack execution + scheduled Cloud Run operator; Firestore metadata and private Cloud Storage evidence

worker.egress: all traffic through Direct VPC; deny Internet; allow only dedicated storage/broker endpoint needed for job input/output; no model/Stripe access
worker.input_access: one job-scoped input object; tool-created copy only
worker.credentials: no static keys; narrowly scoped workload identity
worker.image: UNBUILT; pin Linux Python 3.13 + Temurin 21 JRE and existing KoSIT 1.6.3/bundles by digest before release

remaining_implementation: real Stripe sandbox and operator provisioning
